apis.name: Wikidata Query Service
apis.why_notable: SPARQL endpoint for structured encyclopedic knowledge linking entities across Wikimedia projects.

apis.name: DBpedia SPARQL
apis.why_notable: Linked open data extracted from Wikipedia; foundational for semantic and educational knowledge graphs.

apis.name: Britannica Academic API
apis.why_notable: Commercial encyclopedia content API for licensed article and media access in learning products.

apis.name: World Bank Education API
apis.why_notable: Global education indicators (enrollment, literacy, spending) via World Bank open data REST endpoints.

apis.name: U.S. Department of Education Data
apis.why_notable: Federal education open data including colleges, K-12, and financial-aid datasets via data.gov.

apis.name: College Scorecard API
apis.why_notable: U.S. higher-ed outcomes: costs, graduation rates, earnings by institution and field of study.

apis.name: EdX API
apis.why_notable: Open edX / edX course catalog and learner platform APIs for MOOC integration.

apis.name: Udemy Affiliate API
apis.why_notable: Course catalog search and affiliate data for the large commercial online-learning marketplace.

apis.name: Khan Academy API
apis.why_notable: Free K–12 and lifelong learning content tree, exercises, and video metadata.

apis.name: Canvas LMS API
apis.why_notable: Dominant higher-ed LMS REST API for courses, assignments, grades, and enrollments.

apis.name: Moodle Web Services
apis.why_notable: Open-source LMS web-service API used worldwide for course and user integration.

apis.name: Google Books API
apis.why_notable: Book metadata, previews, and volumes search—core reference for libraries and reading apps.

apis.name: Internet Archive API
apis.why_notable: Massive public-domain books, texts, and media via Search, Metadata, and related APIs.

apis.name: British National Bibliography API
apis.why_notable: British Library bibliographic open data for UK published works (Linked Data / SPARQL heritage).

apis.name: Crossref REST API
apis.why_notable: DOI metadata for scholarly articles—essential academic reference and citation plumbing.

apis.name: OpenAlex
apis.why_notable: Free scholarly graph of works, authors, institutions replacing Microsoft Academic Graph.

apis.name: Semantic Scholar API
apis.why_notable: AI-powered academic paper search, citations, and recommendations from Allen Institute.

apis.name: CORE API
apis.why_notable: Aggregates open-access research papers worldwide for full-text scholarly search.

apis.name: Quotable
apis.why_notable: Free open-source random and filtered quotes API popular with developers and demos.

apis.name: API Ninjas Quotes
apis.why_notable: Simple quotes endpoint among many reference utilities; free tier with API key.

apis.name: Forvo Pronunciation API
apis.why_notable: Crowdsourced word pronunciations in many languages for language-learning apps.

apis.name: Lingua.com API / Tatoeba
apis.why_notable: Multilingual sentence corpus with translations—gold standard for language-learning datasets/API access.

apis.name: AnkiConnect
apis.why_notable: Local HTTP API to control Anki decks—widely used by spaced-repetition language learners (local only).

apis.name: DeepL API
apis.why_notable: High-quality translation used heavily in language learning and education tooling; free tier exists.

apis.name: LibreTranslate
apis.why_notable: Open-source self-hostable translation HTTP API for privacy-friendly language education apps.
